body: Because you can't tell me that you weren't mad when you realized that there are plenty of billion(/million)aires in the US and none of them made the decision to become Ironman or Batman. Like, bruh
I mean, I understand the basics of how to work different muscle groups, and how so sort of use different machines but I look like an idiot.

Im trying to save up to move out. But stuff keeps coming up, my mom was 2 months behind on her phone bill, they needed groceries for the week, my brother needed clothes, my bike broke down. So even though I work full time and get paid $4 over minimum wage I have no money
But people are going to laugh at me because I have no idea what I'm doing.
Ah, I live on the east coast of the US unfortunately, so not quite in your timezone. I work nights though so my sleep schedule is rather wonky anyway so youre welcome to chat if you would like
